name: qcdd-ry-cz-four-body-phase-parity

measurement.coherent: connected_YYYY(0,1,2,3) across key_a and key_b registers
measurement.dephasing_channel: complete computational-basis dephasing on key_b qubits 1 and 3

symmetry.enforcement: tied local parameters, symmetric CZ edges, and symmetric Pauli products

cost.native_gate_and_routing_assumption: unknown; Stage-0 uses exact statevector and makes no hardware-runtime claim

noise_and_shots.shot_estimate: analytic Pauli variance for 95% positive-vs-hardest-negative ranking stability

descriptor_provenance.note: The measurement changed but the state-preparation family did not; descriptors are reused only as design diagnostics.

main_failure_mode: the four-body coherent differential remains reproducible by the equal-parameter sine/cosine bilinear control or requires excessive shots
